CustomField.description: Formula field to display the Latest_Expected_Start_Date__c field in a user-friendly way
CustomField.formula: TEXT(DAY( Latest_Expected_Start_Date__c )) + "-" + CASE( MONTH( Latest_Expected_Start_Date__c ), 1, "JAN", 2, "FEB", 3, "MAR", 4, "APR", 5, "MAY", 6, "JUN", 7, "JUL", 8, "AUG", 9, "SEP", 10, "OCT", 11, "NOV", 12, "DEC", "" ) + "-" + TEXT(YEAR( Latest_Expected_Start_Date__c ))
CustomField.label: Latest Expected Start Date
